name: io.github.tonyyang0504/baidu_marketing-mcp
description: 百度营销 Baidu Marketing (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resu

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIDU_MARKETING_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your application's appId (商业开发者中心 → 应用管理 → 应用详情).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIDU_MARKETING_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The application's secretKey (shown in the approved application's details).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIDU_MARKETING_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: refreshToken from exchanging the authorization code once at POST https://u.baidu.com/oauth/accessToken (valid 30 days; each refresh returns a new one, saved when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIDU_MARKETING_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: userId of the promotion account that authorized the app (returned by the OAuth callback / accessToken exchange).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BAIDU_MARKETING_USER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: 推广账户名称 (userName) of the account to operate — sent as header.userName; with a super-admin (超管) authorization this may be any sub-account.
